story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by knights and knaves. Knights always tell the truth, and knaves always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Evelyn, and Aurora. Evelyn was heard saying, "if Aurora is a knave then Evelyn is a knight". "Aurora is a knight if and only if Evelyn is a knave," Aurora claimed. So who is a knight and who is a knave? (Format your answer like: "Evelyn is a knight/knave, and Aurora is a knight/knave")

options: Evelyn is a knight, Aurora is a knave
Evelyn is a knave, Aurora is a knave
Evelyn is a knave, Aurora is a knight
Evelyn is a knight, Aurora is a knight
